an_end_1: Honestly, at first, I wanted to type out Sora explaining about his story to Hestia and Bell.
an_end_2: But I soon found that it was a chore to deal with, so I've decided to skip the nitty gritty and summarize what Sora has explained and move the plot along.
an_end_3: Also, Sora gave a very summarized version of his journey. He didn't really describe the worlds he travelled to, so expect Bell and Hestia to ask a few things about Sora's journey.
an_end_4: Did you honestly think that Link to All was just a Skill that creates Skills and Magic when fighting alongside Sora? Nope, think again.
an_end_5: It's been repeatedly stated how Sora's heart is able to connect with so many people, and Sora keeps saying that his friends are his power. So I've decided to conceptualize Sora's friendship power into a Skill, Link to All.
an_end_6: At first, it WAS going to be a Skill that creates Skills and Magic between Sora and other party members, just like in the Kingdom Hearts games. But then I thought what Sora can do to influence Bell to grow stronger, because I like Bell as a protagonist as well. I don't want Bell to be overshadowed by Sora.
an_end_7: So I figured, why not a Growth booster? It explains why Sora's party is able to grow and keep up with him when they go fight Heartless.
an_end_8: Before Donald and Goofy met Sora in KH1, they were struggling to fight off Soldier Heartless. But by the time of KH3, they were able to keep up with Sora and fight the ridiculous opponents he faces.
an_end_9: Hell, Sora claimed that Donald or Goofy alone could take on an individual Titan from Hercules's world. The same monsters that gave Zeus, a God, trouble.
an_end_10: Sora's party needs to be strong in their own right to help out Sora in his fights, which helps prove Sora's principle of his friends being his power.
an_end_11: In any case, Sora's Link to All is essentially an inverse Liaris Freese. Rather than boosting the user's growth, it effectively boosts the people around the user based on the bond between the user and partner, rather than personal feeling.
an_end_12: Basically, I'm going to crank up Bell's already ridiculous growth even further than he ever did in canon.
an_end_13: Now then, I hope that I set the right Heartless for Bell to fight when fighting alongside Sora.
an_end_14: Considering how he's currently a beginner, I thought giving him the Shadow and Soldier Heartless, and a Large body Heartless as the 'boss' was a good starter enemy for Bell to deal with. And it was his first time dealing with Heartless, so he was inexperienced as well. So it was pretty much a tough fight for Bell to be in.
an_end_15: Honestly, I'd like to think that low rank Heartless are far more stronger and dangerous compared to Upper Floor Monsters from the dungeon. If I had to compare, I would put Shadows to be a a few floors stronger compared to a Goblin from the first floor.
an_end_16: I'd also like to imagine that Heartless can take far more punishment compared to your average monster.
an_end_17: I remember reading a review how Heartless are "world killers" and how they're dangerous beings. I can certainly acknowledge that. However, I feel that's more of a conceptual type of power than pure power.
an_end_18: To simplify, the Heartless destroying worlds is basically the equivalent of them finding the world's self destruct button (consuming its heart), rather than pure power destroying the world itself, like how Goku's Kamehameha can totally destroy a planet at full blast.
an_end_19: It's like a human piloting a robot and hitting the self-destruct button. They certainly destroyed the robot, but only with a button rather than punching the robot itself.
an_end_20: Because if Heartless were at literal world killer power, I'm pretty sure that everyone except Sora in the story would die immediately. That wouldn't make a good story now, wouldn't it?
an_end_21: Honestly, trying to understand/justify/categorize Kingdom Hearts Power Levels is more harder than comprehending the Kingdom Hearts plot, lore, and universal rules. I'm going to write the way Heartless are in my story. End of Discussion.
